run_migrate_checkpoint_cli: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI tool to convert an OCP checkpoint to fm_release format with input and output paths
run_migrate_checkpoint_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI tool with --add-stress flag to add stress tasks for datasets missing them
run_migrate_checkpoint_remove_static: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI tool with --remove-static-keys to remove obsolete keys from model state dictionaries
run_migrate_checkpoint_model_version: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI tool with --model-version to inject a specific model version into the backbone config
run_migrate_checkpoint_task_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI tool with --map-undefined-stress-to to copy stress task configs to datasets that lack them
